## Standing operator rules
Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.

All changelog entries mentioning tax handling must include the Jira issue key in parentheses and be tagged with the `tax-doc` label by @marco.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Please paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

## Current objective
Finish the invoice-list pagination change; prior SQLAlchemy upgrade remains on hold.

## Key identifiers and corrections
`InvoicePage`; `InvoiceService.list_invoices(limit=20, offset=0)`; tests `tests/api/test_invoice_pagination.py`; summary path `ledgerly/reports/invoice_summary.py`; runner `ci-runner-arm64` (`ci-runner-small` superseded).

## Ruled-out approaches
`invoices(customer_id, created_at)` covering index doubled ingest write latency. Repeated direct inserts/per-test setup were replaced by factories/fixtures. Adding `items` assertions for HTTP 422 validation errors was invalid.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Pagination route/service/schema changes, 9 invoice API tests, 3 pagination tests, 18 billing tests, 18 summary tests, Ruff, and `git diff --check`.
- [done] `actionlint .github/workflows/test.yml && echo 'workflow syntax valid'` exited 0.
- [pending] Update integration workflow runner, then vendor-credit CSV importer; next: `git status --short && sed -n '1,160p' ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`
